clue.text: Display consisting of just a single glass?

definitions.meaning: an impressive public show or sight
a playful reading: the plural word for eyeglasses made singular, as if naming just one lens

explanation.surface: A drinks display made up of nothing but one lonely glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Consisting of' joins the two senses. The question mark flags the whimsy: if a pair of glasses is plural, one glass might be the singular.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand show or sight is a synonym in the display sense; the second sense jokingly singularises eyewear.

clue.text: Choose to make allusion to parking first

indicators.note: first says the parking letter comes at the front of the charade

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for parking on road signs
to make allusion to something is to refer to it

explanation.surface: Someone chooses to mention parking before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: To favour one option over another is to pick it, a close synonym.

clue.text: About fifty always appear quick-witted

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'

explanation.surface: Someone around fifty who always seems sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp, intelligent and fast-thinking: a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: A highway of lesser importance? Not in this country

parts.note: ... is a British minor road, ranking below the main A roads

explanation.surface: A question about a minor road, then a remark about being overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain roads are graded A (major) and B (minor); a B road is the lesser highway, so 'A highway of lesser importance' is A B-ROAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being overseas or in a foreign land means away from one's home country.

clue.text: Means of bearing youngsters!

definitions.meaning: stretchers or carried couches on which people are borne
broods of young animals born at one time, such as puppies

explanation.surface: An exclamation about how a mother animal carries her babies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' tempts as giving birth; it is carrying, as with a sedan chair or stretcher.
explanation.definitionFit: Carried couches or stretchers are one sense; a brood of newborn animals, like kittens, is the other.

clue.text: Pay deputy-head is to order

indicators.note: head of the word deputy means its first letter only

parts.note: to charge someone with a task is to order or command them to do it

explanation.surface: A deputy head teacher is instructed about salary.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle or clear a debt is to pay it off.

clue.text: Whip round an MP has to get cheese

indicators.note: round means the whip word goes around the words for an MP

parts.note: a cat (cat-o'-nine-tails) is a whip
an MP is a Member of Parliament, so a member

explanation.surface: A party whip pressures an MP, who ends up with cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whip' suggests the parliamentary whip beside 'MP'; it is the lash called a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft French variety from Normandy is an example of cheese.

clue.text: Fruit drink fit for the gods in the Orient

parts.note: in Greek myth the gods drank nectar
E, east, is the Orient

explanation.surface: A heavenly fruit drink served somewhere in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned variety of peach is an example of fruit.

clue.text: A taking individual in the main

definitions.text: A taking individual in the main

parts.words: A taking individual in the main
parts.note: taking means stealing, and the main is the open sea, so a thief at sea

explanation.definitionFit: A sea robber is someone who takes ships' goods on the open ocean.

clue.text: Be festive but let care be exercised

indicators.note: exercised suggests the letters are worked about and put through their paces into a new order

explanation.surface: Have a party, but make sure everyone takes care.
explanation.definitionFit: To mark an occasion with festivities is to party.

clue.text: Admit ruling is needed about the mushroom

indicators.note: about means the ruling word goes around the mushroom word

parts.note: an act is a legal ruling passed by a parliament
a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcini

explanation.surface: A regulation concerning the mushroom must be acknowledged.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone or something is to take it in, a synonym.

clue.text: Even corrupt classes can get honours

indicators.note: corrupt says the letters of even are spoiled into a different order

parts.note: rates are classes, as in first-rate or second-rate

explanation.surface: Even crooked social classes may receive titles.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere or hold in deep respect is a synonym of this verb sense.

clue.text: There won't be cuts to face if he does his job properly

definitions.text: There won't be cuts to face if he does his job properly

parts.words: There won't be cuts to face if he does his job properly
parts.note: cuts to face sounds like hardship ahead, but means nicks on a shaved face

explanation.definitionFit: A man who shaves and trims customers should leave no nicks.

clue.text: The council having business met, time being somehow made for this

parts.note: CO is short for company, a business

indicators.note: somehow means met time is reshaped in some way

explanation.surface: A council meets on business, with time somehow found for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' rearranges MET TIME into MMITTEE, placed after CO.
explanation.definitionFit: A group appointed for a task is a kind of council or board.

clue.text: He'll speak to a daughter on get-up with some hesitation

parts.note: D abbreviates daughter in family trees
a get-up is an outfit, a dress
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone will hesitantly speak to a daughter about her outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who speaks to an audience; the agent noun of a verb meaning to speak to.

clue.text: Freedom from aches and pains — unusual in age alas!

indicators.note: unusual means the letters of in age alas appear in an odd order

explanation.surface: Lamenting that being free of aches is rare at one's age.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical term for absence of pain sensation; painkillers produce it.

clue.text: Animal dope

explanation.definitionFit: A donkey is the animal; a fool or idiot is the second sense.

clue.text: There's a couple of pounds for everyone

parts.note: L is a pound (librum), so two pounds is two Ls

explanation.surface: A couple of pounds is available for each person.
explanation.definitionFit: Every person together, a synonym.

clue.text: Secret agent seen in his pyjamas

indicators.note: seen in signals the letters are tucked inside his pyjamas

explanation.surface: A secret agent spotted in his nightwear.
explanation.definitionFit: An undercover operative gathering intelligence is a secret agent.

clue.text: A number may have spoken about the commotion

indicators.note: about means the spoken word goes around the commotion word

parts.note: oral means spoken, as in an oral exam
din is a loud noise or commotion

explanation.surface: Several people may have commented on the disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: A number such as first or second, denoting position, is this kind.

clue.text: The beastly element?

parts.note: a chemical element named after a farm animal: a crude form of the metal Fe

explanation.definitionFit: Crude iron from a blast furnace bears a farmyard beast's name.

clue.text: Produce eggs for a song

definitions.meaning: a ballad or short poem to be sung

explanation.surface: Laying for a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A hen does this; also an old word for a ballad or song.

clue.text: Mean to declare date of birth?

parts.note: to aver is to declare or assert
your date of birth tells your age, hence the question mark

explanation.surface: Is it unkind to reveal when someone was born?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like unkind; it is the arithmetic middle value.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic the middle value of a set is its mean.

clue.text: Heart causing a doctor real perplexity

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor

indicators.note: perplexity suggests the letters of real are confused and jumbled

explanation.surface: A heart condition baffles the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart in the sense of spirit or confidence, as in losing heart.

clue.text: Room must be found by the boss before ten

indicators.note: before puts the boss word ahead of the ten

parts.note: a stud is a boss, a raised knob
IO looks like the number 10

explanation.surface: An office room must be located by the manager ahead of ten o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boss' suggests a manager; it is an ornamental knob.
explanation.definitionFit: A workroom for an artist or a broadcasting room.

clue.text: Star actors maybe

indicators.note: maybe means the letters of actors might be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Actors who might be stars.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the two bright stars of Gemini, twin of Pollux.

clue.text: A dive making small change to charge

parts.note: p is a penny, small change in British money
a lunge is a sudden charge forward

explanation.surface: A diving board costs only a little extra.
explanation.definitionFit: A plunge is a headlong dive into water.

clue.text: Having very little American cash, meet half-way

parts.note: a cent is a tiny amount of US money
a rally is a meet or gathering

explanation.surface: Short of dollars, let's compromise.
explanation.definitionFit: In the middle, midway between two points.

clue.text: The heartless and almost grim examiner

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter of the word the is removed
almost means the last letter of the grim word is lost

parts.note: stern means grim or severe

explanation.surface: A heartless, nearly grim examiner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tests or checks.

clue.text: A town girl's sound character

parts.note: a maid is a girl, with the possessive kept
tone is the character or quality of a sound

explanation.surface: A town girl has a lovely voice.
explanation.walkthrough: MAIDSTONE is the county town of Kent in south-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: The county town of Kent is an example of a town.

clue.text: Agree one could be made over by a female adviser

indicators.note: made over means the letters are remodelled into a new form

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A woman advisor can be agreed upon.
explanation.definitionFit: Egeria was the nymph who counselled King Numa; the name now means a woman counsellor.

clue.text: Concerned with origins and capital assets

parts.note: re means concerning, as in letter headings
sources are origins

explanation.surface: Concerning origins and financial assets.
explanation.definitionFit: Funds and supplies a company holds as wealth.
